description: Manage Datadog Logs pipelines (parsing & processor chains). Actions: list, get, create, update, delete, reorder, get_order. Pipelines run sequentially on incoming logs; reorder changes the structure of downstream data. Mutations are blocked when the server is in read-only mode. Unknown processor types in 'config.processors' are forwarded to Datadog unchanged.

config.description: Pipeline configuration (for create/update). Requires name and filter.query. Processors are forwarded unchanged.

pipeline_ids.description: Ordered pipeline ID list (required for reorder)

verbose.description: Return full SDK payload alongside summary (default false)

name: logs_pipelines
